shortDescription: S&P Global said on September 3 that Japan's August services PMI came in at 52.5 and its composite PMI at 53.5, according to Jiemian News. The readings indicate expansion in both services and overall private-sector activity.

children: S&P Global said on September 3 that Japan's August services PMI came in at 52.5 and its composite PMI at 53.5, according to Jiemian News. The readings indicate expansion in both services and overall private-sector activity.

title: Japan's August Services PMI Rises to 52.5, Composite PMI to 53.5
